state.spec: Generate packages/flow/src/flow/builder/app.py: a Terminal-UI shell 'BuilderApp' for the flow workflow builder. It must satisfy the acceptance contract in packages/flow/tests/test_builder_app.py exactly.

nodes.system_prompt: You are a Python software designer working in the x-dog monorepo. Read files with the filesystem tool before designing. Produce a precise, minimal plan.
nodes.prompt:
Design packages/flow/src/flow/builder/app.py.

FIRST read these files to learn the exact API and contract:
- packages/flow/tests/test_builder_app.py  (THE acceptance contract you must satisfy)
- packages/flow/src/flow/builder/model.py   (BuilderModel, empty_model, model_from_workflow)
- packages/flow/src/flow/builder/actions.py  (pure edit ops: add_node, remove_node, select, ...)
- packages/flow/src/flow/graph.py            (to_ascii for the preview)
- packages/tui/src/tui/tui.py                (Component base: render/handle_input; TUI; Container)
- packages/tui/src/tui/keys.py               (KeyEvent shape)

The module must provide: class BuilderApp(Component); build_app(path) -> BuilderApp; run(path) -> None (blocking, may be excluded from coverage with a pragma). Output your plan.

nodes.system_prompt: You are a senior Python engineer. Write production code: `from __future__ import annotations`, full type annotations (the gate runs mypy --strict), ruff-clean (line-length 120), no unused imports. Read the referenced files with the filesystem tool, then WRITE the target file with the filesystem 'write' action. Do not write any other file.
nodes.prompt:
Implement packages/flow/src/flow/builder/app.py per this plan:

{{plan}}

Requirements:
- class BuilderApp(Component) from tui.tui, with render(self, width: int) -> list[str] and handle_input(self, event: KeyEvent) -> bool.
- Delegate ALL edits to flow.builder.actions (add_node/remove_node/select/...); hold a BuilderModel and expose it via a `model` property.
- build_app(path: str | Path) -> BuilderApp: load via flow.loader.load_workflow + flow.builder.model.model_from_workflow if the path exists, else flow.builder.model.empty_model(name=<file stem>).
- Keys: 'a' add agent node, 's' add script node, 'j'/'down' + 'k'/'up' move selection, 'd' remove selected; unknown keys return False.
- render(width) returns a non-empty list[str] listing every node id plus a validation status line; use flow.graph.to_ascii for a preview.
- run(path) -> None builds a TUI, adds the app, set_focus, start() in try/finally; mark it `# pragma: no cover`.
- Read packages/flow/tests/test_builder_app.py again and make every test pass. WRITE the file, then report the path you wrote.

nodes.system_prompt: You are a build reviewer. If the verdict starts with PASS, status is 'approved'. If it starts with FAIL, status is 'revise' and feedback must quote the exact ruff/mypy/pytest errors to fix.
